definitions.explanation: The point at which something began or first came into existence. Used for the origins of words, customs, species, civilizations, and phenomena.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起源|きげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: Look up the origin of a word.

examples.japanese: ⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起源|きげん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦ギリシャ→ギリシャ：28897_girisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The Olympics have their origins in ancient Greece.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起源|きげん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧さまざまな⟦{学説|がくせつ}→学説：08102_gakusetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{解明|かいめい}→解明：14164_kaimei⟧⟦されていない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: There are various theories about the origin of life, but it has not yet been fully explained.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for the historical or primordial beginning of something. The pattern 〜⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起源|きげん} (the origin of ~) is extremely common. Appears frequently in academic, scientific, and cultural contexts.

NOTE: Not to be confused with the homophones ⟦{期限|きげん}→期限：12861_kigen⟧ (deadline, time limit), ⟦{機嫌|きげん}→機嫌：02367_kigen⟧ (mood, temper), or ⟦{紀元|きげん}→紀元：13822_kigen⟧ (era, epoch).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {起源|きげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧たどる (to trace the origin)
- {起源|きげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さぐ}る→探る：03923_saguru⟧ (to investigate the origin)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{起源|きげん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (to have its origin in ~)
- ⟦{生命|せいめい}→生命：03296_seimei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起源|きげん} (the origin of life)
- ⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{起源|きげん} (the origin of civilization)
